## Skills
A skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file. Below is the list of skills that can be used. Each entry includes a name, description, and a short path that can be expanded into an absolute path using the skill roots table.
### Skill roots
- `r0` = `<WORKSPACE>/.agents/skills`
### Available skills
- skill-evaluation: Use this skill when designing, running, interpreting, or reporting Agent Skill evaluations, selecting cases or judges, and analyzing trigger, benchmark, or regression evidence; triggers include Skill evaluation and evaluation design. (file: r0/skill-evaluation/SKILL.md)
</skills_instructions>
